common_assumptions: file paths exist as expected from prior session context
tools and runtimes (go, adb, brew, gcloud) are installed and on PATH
git repository state matches what was last observed
external services and network endpoints are reachable
prior session work was committed or persisted correctly
strength_patterns: Systematic file exploration precedes implementation in multi-step tasks
Verification steps (test runs, log inspection, diff checks) consistently follow modifications
Targeted grep and read patterns show efficient scoped information gathering
weakness_patterns: Repeated reads of identical files within a single chain without intervening writes, indicating fixation loops
Extremely long chains (76–403 steps) proceed without intermediate direction pivots or progress checks
Environment assumptions (tool availability, file existence, prior state) are rarely verified before acting on them
